class.name: HTMLComponent
class.brief_description: A GDScript component instance associated with one HTML element.
class.description: Register a GDScript subclass through HTMLLabel.component_scripts or a script element with type="text/gdscript" and a component attribute. Document declarations override the label registry. Component construction takes no required arguments. Enable HTMLLabel.behaviors_enabled to run components. Timers, requests, and frame callbacks use the inherited behavior runtime.

method.name: _mount
method.description: Called once after host and document have been assigned. Initialize the shadow tree and event listeners here.

method.name: _connected
method.description: Called when the host is connected, including reconnection.

method.name: _disconnected
method.description: Called when the host is removed from the document.

method.name: _unmount
method.description: Called before releasing this component on reload or document teardown. Release event listeners here.

members.member: The element associated with this component.
The host's shadow root, including a closed root.
